patterns.text: ~~132,843 COIN in LEDGER vs ~5,500 in WALLETs~~ — CLOSED: `vault reconcile` bridges LEDGER to WALLETs, `vault mint` processes gradients idempotently
.idf gradient field (to_bits - from_bits) is the natural COIN amount — governance score improvement = economic value
Dedup by idf_id in work_ref prevents double-minting on commit amend or hook re-run
Only DEXTER commits to git — identity mapping is 1:1 initially, federation comes later
`vault reconcile` bridges LEDGER gradients to WALLET events — idempotent via work_ref dedup, handles both MINT (positive gradient) and DRIFT (negative gradient)
